name: Kanojo-tachi no Jijou
source:
Main character is a student detective. He pursues a beautiful girl kidnapping case and wanders around looking for clues and talking to different girls. Can he solve this case?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名学生侦探。他追查一起美少女绑架案件，四处寻找线索并与不同的女孩交谈。他能破解这个案件吗？

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-april-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
